mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_account (organization_id, host, port, username, encrypted_password, ssl, folder, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.organizationId}, #{row.host}, #{row.port}, #{row.username}, #{row.encryptedPassword}, #{row.ssl}, #{row.folder}, #{row.enabled}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_account SET uid_validity = CASE WHEN host = #{row.host} AND username = #{row.username} AND folder = #{row.folder} THEN uid_validity ELSE 0 END, last_uid = CASE WHEN host = #{row.host} AND username = #{row.username} AND folder = #{row.folder} THEN last_uid ELSE 0 END, host = #{row.host}, port = #{row.port}, username = #{row.username}, encrypted_password = #{row.encryptedPassword}, ssl = #{row.ssl}, folder = #{row.folder}, enabled = #{row.enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE organization_id = #{row.organizationId} AND version = #{version} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT a.organization_id FROM mail_account a JOIN organization o ON o.id = a.organization_id AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.enabled AND a.next_sync_at <= #{now} AND (a.lease_until IS NULL OR a.lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY a.next_sync_at LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_account SET lease_token = #{token}, lease_until = CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) + interval '5 minutes' WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND enabled AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})

UPDATE mail_account SET uid_validity = #{validity}, last_uid = #{uid}, last_error = #{error}, last_sync_at = CASE WHEN #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) ELSE last_sync_at END, next_sync_at = CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) + interval '1 minute', lease_until = NULL, lease_token = NULL WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND lease_token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_message (id, organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, action_request_id, interaction_id, thread_id, parent_id, direction, status, message_id, from_address, recipients, subject, body_text, attachment_names, references_header, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.organizationId}, #{row.customerId}, #{row.ownerMemberId}, #{row.actionRequestId}, #{row.interactionId}, #{row.threadId}, #{row.parentId}, #{row.direction}, #{row.status}, #{row.messageId}, #{row.fromAddress}, #{row.recipients,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbStringListTypeHandler}, #{row.subject}, #{row.bodyText}, #{row.attachmentNames,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbStringListTypeHandler}, #{row.referencesHeader}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: FROM mail_message m LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = m.organization_id AND c.id = m.customer_id LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.organization_id = m.organization_id AND a.id = m.reply_approval_id LEFT JOIN action_request ar ON ar.organization_id = a.organization_id AND ar.id = a.action_request_id
m.organization_id = #{org} AND (m.customer_id IS NULL OR c.deleted_at IS NULL) AND m.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.owner_member_id = #{owner} OR c.owner_member_id IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.owner_member_id, a.status AS approval_status, ar.status AS action_status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mail_message d WHERE d.organization_id = m.organization_id AND d.parent_id = m.id AND d.direction = 'OUTBOUND' AND d.status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')) AS delivery_uncertain WHERE m.organization_id = #{org} AND m.id = #{id} AND (m.customer_id IS NULL OR c.deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT c.id, c.owner_member_id, c.name FROM customer c WHERE c.organization_id = #{org} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_contact cc WHERE cc.organization_id = c.organization_id AND cc.customer_id = c.id AND cc.deleted_at IS NULL AND lower(btrim(cc.email)) = #{email}) LIMIT 2
SELECT id, owner_member_id, name FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.id, m.organization_id, m.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.owner_member_id, m.direction, m.status, m.subject, left(m.body_text, 300) AS body_text, m.from_address, m.recipients, m.attachment_names, m.occurred_at, m.created_at, m.thread_id, m.parent_id, m.version, m.reply_approval_id, a.status AS approval_status, ar.status AS action_status WHERE
AND m.direction = 'INBOUND' AND m.status = 'RECEIVED' AND m.status = 'UNMATCHED' AND m.direction = 'OUTBOUND' AND m.direction = 'INBOUND' AND m.status IN ('HANDLED', 'REPLIED', 'IGNORED')
ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC, m.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interaction (id, organization_id, customer_id, type, direction, occurred_at, subject, body_text, body_preview, participants, source, external_id, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{row.interactionId}, #{row.organizationId}, #{row.customerId}, CASE WHEN #{row.direction} = 'INBOUND' THEN 'EMAIL_RECEIVED' ELSE 'EMAIL_SENT' END, #{row.direction}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.subject}, #{row.bodyText}, left(#{row.bodyText}, 500), #{row.recipients,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbStringListTypeHandler}, 'EMAIL', CAST(#{row.id} AS text), jsonb_build_object('mailMessageId', CAST(#{row.id} AS text), 'messageId', CAST(#{row.messageId} AS text)), #{row.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET last_interaction_at = GREATEST(last_interaction_at, #{row.occurredAt}), updated_at = #{row.createdAt} WHERE organization_id = #{row.organizationId} AND id = #{row.customerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE mail_message SET version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND version = #{version} AND AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mail_message delivery WHERE delivery.organization_id = mail_message.organization_id AND delivery.parent_id = mail_message.id AND delivery.direction = 'OUTBOUND' AND delivery.status IN ('SENDING', 'SENT', 'UNKNOWN'))
UPDATE mail_message SET reply_approval_id = #{approval} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE follow_up SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND mail_message_id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED')
